name: Brief answer
text: Answer the asked dimension directly. Lead with the result. Use plain language and a few short bullets where helpful. Include only the evidence needed to assess the answer.

name: Review request
text: Review this for consequential correctness issues. Ground findings in the actual code and explain a concrete failure scenario. Prioritize by impact and give the smallest sound fix. If there are no actionable findings, say so.

name: Architecture options
text: Show ideal, first-principles options optimized for type safety and developer experience. Explain the consumer-facing API with small examples. Compare meaningful tradeoffs and recommend one option.
